basis.benchmark_price: Observed mean of 249 available 2023 Henry Hub daily prices; not site netback.
basis.economic_coefficients: All capture, sellable fraction, heating value, cost, lifetime and discount coefficients are explicit screening assumptions, not measured site composition or installation quotes.
basis.pipeline_distance: Nearest downloaded line segment; no evidence of feasible access, capacity, rights, or construction route. Geometry vintage is not established as 2023.
basis.volume: Satellite-estimated 2023 annual gas; constant annual baseline, not observed hourly operation.
basis.payback: Simple undiscounted capex / first-year positive margin; not a claim payback occurs within project life.
basis.edge_effect: Flag if nearest downloaded segment is farther than the clipped-data boundary. Unflagged distances exclude only clipping edge effects, not missing inventory.
